relations.statement: If positive and negative weight spectra of a TrotterPath are disjoint, no weight-preserving sign-reversing involution exists.
relations.hypotheses: DisjointWeightSpectra T, a path p_minus with negative sign

relations.statement: Unequal natural weights w_pos and w_neg give nonzero signed residual w_pos*(+1)+w_neg*(-1).

lemmas.statement: Zero signed mass need not come from an involution: the unequal three-term sum 2-1-1 equals 0 with unequal weights.
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem l_three_term_cancel : ([2, -1, -1] : List Int).sum = 0 := by decide

near_misses.claim: Each finite quantum system either has a certified polynomial-time sign-eliminating involution or is NP-hard.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: NP-hardness is a property of input families with an encoding, not of a single finite system; every finite instance is trivially solvable.

near_misses.claim: No equal-weight involution in the declared basis implies a sign obstruction that is hard.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The free triangle has no such involution in its basis yet is solved by one-body diagonalization.

open_obligations: Formalize the free triangle one-body diagonalization solvability with a sorry-free proof.
